body:
Medii Kitchen in Anaheim Hills is a gem!

Also, Latte Da (also Anaheim Hills) for dinner, excellent upscale Italian.

Terra Wood-Fired Kitchen in Yorba Linda.

author: electric_blue_82
body: Terra Wood Fire is such a hidden gem. 💎 it’s amazing and they are opening up a butchery/deli of some sort across the street very soon.
